title: [BUG] future request, allow user edits in generated code as well.
body:
well i like it that claude can edit code and show it sometimes within react.
I can quickly preview some designs.

**PROBLEM** :
Whats currently not possible though to edit that code that claude creates by a user 
It would be be nice to be able to do small edits claude has not to think about it, this is mainly a human edit for the viewer thing, ea alter some of the react code claude generated (or any code not only react), 

only if the user types some new question claude could ask first (or perhaps just a checkbox) to include the user edits (sometimes users screw things up) if checked claude could read the edits what the user did and then continue the discussion if the checkbox was not checked claude can ignore the user edits.
BTW quite neat how claude now corrects its own react output.

for example for a starburst effect, or some layout, a user themselves could as well just update a small part
no need to ask claude to make it brighter or faster darker or more darkish green, a user can type such small edits as well in code.
Often edits are so small this should not take a lot of your server farm thinking if a user could do it, i think it will consume less resources for Antrophic.
author: PGTBoos
